frontMatter.title: Wednesday Club Night: League Action at Claremont Stadium
frontMatter.summary: Wednesday Club Night at Claremont Stadium Grade 2 Mens (Navan vs Julianstown), Grade 6 Mixed (Navan ‘A’ vs Mullagh), plus two courts open from 8:30pm. Juvenile night is league matches only.'
